The Role of Risk and Time Preferences in Household Decision to Adopt Solar Panels
Behavioral preferences and contract choice in the residential solar PV market
abstract: Greater adoption of renewable energy technologies by households is a key component of decarbonization and energy transition goals. Although existing literature has examined how sociodemographic characteristics, “green” preferences, and peer effects impact adoption of new energy technology, the role of behavioral preferences has not been adequately studied. In this paper, we examine the effect of two types of behavioral preferences, namely the degree of risk tolerance (risk preference) and attitude toward delayed reward (time preference) on the contract decision to lease or own a solar photovoltaic (PV) system. We develop a theoretical framework to show that the effect of risk and time preferences on the relative utilities from the two contracts is monotonic: Lower risk aversion and lower discount rate (more patience) imply a higher chance of solar PV ownership. To test these predictions empirically, we first estimate preference parameters (risk aversion and discount rate) from laboratory data collected from solar PV adopters. We then combine the parameter estimates with data on actual solar PV contract choice to examine the relationship between solar PV adopters' time and risk preferences and their lease‐versus‐own choice. Our regression results confirm that less risk averse individuals have a higher tendency to choose the ownership option, whereas more patient individuals are (weakly) more likely to own their solar PV systems. These findings contribute to a greater understanding of the role of behavioral factors in household decisions related to energy technologies.
abstract_zh: 家庭更广泛地采用可再生能源技术，是实现脱碳和能源转型目标的关键组成部分。尽管已有文献考察了社会人口特征、“绿色”偏好及同伴效应对新能源技术采用的影响，但行为偏好的作用尚未得到充分研究。本文考察了两类行为偏好，即风险容忍度（风险偏好）和对延迟回报的态度（时间偏好），对家庭在租赁或购买太阳能光伏系统之间做出合同选择的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，证明风险偏好和时间偏好对两种合同相对效用的影响是单调的：风险厌恶程度越低、贴现率越低（越有耐心），拥有光伏系统的可能性就越高。为了实证检验这些预测，我们首先利用从太阳能光伏采用者收集的实验室数据估计偏好参数（风险厌恶和贴现率），然后将参数估计值与实际光伏合同选择数据相结合，考察光伏采用者的时间偏好和风险偏好与其“租赁还是购买”选择之间的关系。回归结果证实，风险厌恶程度较低的个人更倾向于选择购买，而更有耐心的个人（弱）更可能拥有其光伏系统。这些发现有助于更好地理解行为因素在家庭能源技术决策中的作用。

Equity-aware Decarbonization of Residential Heating Systems
abstract:
Most buildings still rely on fossil energy --- such as oil, coal and natural gas --- for heating. This is because they are readily available and have higher heat value than their cleaner counterparts. However, these primary sources of energy are also high pollutants. As the grid moves towards eliminating CO
2
emission, replacing these sources of energy with cleaner alternatives is imperative. Electric heat pumps --- an alternative and cleaner heating technology --- have been proposed as a viable replacement. In this paper, we conduct a data-driven optimization study to analyze the potential of reducing carbon emission by replacing gas-based heating with electric heat pumps
1
. We do so while enforcing
equity
in such transition. We begin by conducting an in-depth analysis into the energy patterns and demographic profiles of buildings. Our analysis reveals a huge disparity between lower and higher income households. We show that the energy usage intensity for lower income homes is 24% higher than higher income homes. Next, we analyze the potential for carbon emission reduction by transitioning gas-based heating systems to electric heat pumps for an entire city. We then propose equity-aware transition strategies for selecting a subset of customers for heat pump-based retrofits which embed various equity metrics and balances the need to maximize carbon reduction with ensuring equitable outcomes for households. We evaluate their effect on CO
2
emission reduction, showing that such equity-aware carbon emission reduction strategies achieve significant emission reduction while also reducing the disparity in the value of selected homes by 5X compared to a carbon-first approach.
abstract_zh: 大多数建筑仍依赖石油、煤炭和天然气等化石能源供暖，原因在于这些能源容易获得，且热值高于较清洁的替代能源。然而，这些一次能源的污染物排放量也很高。随着电网逐步消除二氧化碳排放，用更清洁的替代能源取代它们已势在必行。电动热泵是一种清洁程度更高的供暖技术，已被认为是可行的替代方案。本文开展了一项数据驱动的优化研究，分析以电动热泵替代燃气供暖的减碳潜力，并在转型过程中强制考虑公平性。我们首先深入分析了建筑的能源使用模式和人口特征，结果显示低收入与高收入家庭之间存在巨大差距：低收入家庭住宅的单位面积能耗强度比高收入家庭高24%。随后，我们分析了整座城市将燃气供暖系统转换为电动热泵的减碳潜力。进而，我们提出了兼顾公平的转型策略，用于选择部分用户进行热泵改造，这些策略纳入了多种公平性指标，并在最大化碳减排与保障家庭公平结果之间取得平衡。我们评估了这些策略对二氧化碳减排的影响，结果表明，兼顾公平的减排策略在实现显著减排的同时，还能将所选住房价值的差距缩小至以碳优先策略为基准的1/5。

Environmental Externalities from Agriculture: Evidence from Water Quality in the United States
abstract: Agricultural fertilizer use is widely acknowledged to be a leading cause of water pollution. Yet, no national estimates exist on the effect of fertilizer application on concentrations of agricultural pollutants in US watersheds. This paper employs a watershed‐level panel data on nitrogen and phosphorus pollution readings to examine the impact of fertilizer use on US water quality over a fifty‐five‐year time period from 1951 to 2005. Findings show that a 10% increase in the use of nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizers leads to a 1.52% increase in the concentration of nitrogen and a 1.37% increase in the concentration of phosphorus across watersheds. Results also indicate that there exists heterogeneity in nutrient pollution elasticity estimates across eighteen US water resource regions, ranging from 0.082 to 0.733 in the case of nitrogen and from 0.036 to 0.475 in the case of phosphorus. Combining our results with prior hydrology‐based studies, we find that a 100% increase in the use of nitrogen fertilizers in the Lower Mississippi water resource region expands the size of the hypoxic zone in the Gulf of Mexico by roughly 3,389 square miles, equivalent to about two‐fifths of the estimated size of the dead zone in the Gulf of Mexico.
abstract_zh: 农业化肥施用被广泛认为是水污染的主要成因。然而，目前尚无关于化肥施用对美国流域农业污染物浓度影响的全国性估计。本文利用流域层面的氮、磷污染监测面板数据，考察了1951至2005年这五十五年间化肥施用对美国水质的影响。研究发现，氮肥和磷肥用量每增加10%，流域内氮浓度增加1.52%，磷浓度增加1.37%。结果还显示，美国十八个水资源区之间的营养物污染弹性存在异质性：氮的弹性估计值在0.082至0.733之间，磷的弹性估计值在0.036至0.475之间。结合以往基于水文学的研究，我们发现，密西西比河下游水资源区的氮肥用量每增加100%，将使墨西哥湾缺氧区的面积扩大约3,389平方英里，相当于墨西哥湾“死区”估计面积的约五分之二。

title: Modeling land use change with biofuels
venue: Book chapter in The Oxford Handbook of Land Economics
abstract: The introduction of biofuels to agriculture has led to a new reality by linking agricultural and livestock sectors with energy markets. This article reviews the underlying assumptions and major findings of models being used to measure the land use impact of biofuels to develop an understanding of the drivers of land use change with biofuels. These studies show that biofuels have the potential to meet a significant percentage of liquid fuel demand and demand for renewable electricity in the future and that current targets being set in the United States and the European Union for renewable fuels are feasible with moderate increases in crop prices. Models differ in their assessment of the magnitude and location of global land use change due to biofuels but show that some trade-offs between food and fuel production are inevitable. High yielding feedstocks and growth in productivity of food crops can mitigate the adverse impacts of biofuels.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料进入农业领域，使农业和畜牧业部门与能源市场联系在一起，形成了新的局面。本文回顾了用于衡量生物燃料土地利用影响的模型的基本假设和主要发现，以理解生物燃料引发土地利用变化的驱动因素。这些研究表明，生物燃料未来有潜力满足相当大比例的液体燃料需求和可再生电力需求；美国和欧盟目前为可再生燃料设定的目标，在作物价格适度上涨的情况下是可行的。不同模型对全球生物燃料引起的土地利用变化的规模和地理位置的评估存在差异，但都表明，粮食与燃料生产之间不可避免地存在某些权衡。高产原料以及粮食作物生产率的增长，可以减轻生物燃料的不利影响。

title: Can India meet biofuel policy targets? Implications for food and fuel prices
Measuring indirect land use change with biofuels: Implications for policy
abstract: The indirect land use change (ILUC) effect of biofuels has called into question the greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation benefit of biofuels compared with that of fossil fuels. This article reviews the various economic modeling approaches being used to assess the ILUC effect and discusses the key factors that influence estimates of its magnitude. We find that there is considerable variability in the magnitude of ILUC associated with a biofuel pathway across studies and within a study, depending on underlying model parameters. These estimates are sensitive to the scale of biofuel production, the mix of policies and biofuels considered, variations in the parametric assumptions that govern price transmission through international trade, and the ease of changes in land use at the intensive and extensive margins. We discuss the challenges in implementing policies to address ILUC.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料的间接土地利用变化（ILUC）效应使人们质疑，与化石燃料相比，生物燃料的温室气体减排效益。本文回顾了用于评估ILUC效应的各种经济建模方法，并讨论了影响其规模估计的关键因素。我们发现，同一生物燃料路径的ILUC规模在不同研究之间，甚至在同一研究内部，都存在相当大的差异，这取决于基础模型参数。这些估计对生物燃料生产规模、所考虑的政策与生物燃料组合、国际贸易中价格传导的参数假设，以及集约和外延边际上土地利用变化的难易程度都很敏感。我们讨论了实施ILUC应对政策所面临的挑战。

title: Dynamics of agricultural wages and rice prices in the Philippines
abstract: Rice trade liberalization in the Philippines should decrease domestic rice prices impacting both agricultural wages and the welfare of agricultural wage earners. This study examines the short‐run and long‐run relationship between rice prices and agricultural wages in the Philippines using a neoclassical wage determination model. Three empirical frameworks are used—a cointegration/error correction framework, which assumes nonstationary variables in long‐run equilibrium, a first difference model that assumes nonstationary variables but no long‐run equilibrium, and an OLS framework that assumes the model variables are stationary. Conclusions are reasonably robust across the three empirical frameworks with wages adjusting positively to rice price changes with a short‐run elasticity of 0.29 to 0.57, and a long‐run elasticity of 0.70 to 1.0 in preferred models. An analysis of welfare implications suggests that although households that are heavily reliant on agricultural wages for income will be adversely affected by rice price decreases, other households will benefit.
abstract_zh: 菲律宾的大米贸易自由化应会压低国内大米价格，进而影响农业工资及农业工资劳动者的福利。本研究采用新古典工资决定模型，考察菲律宾大米价格与农业工资之间的短期和长期关系。本文使用三种实证框架：协整/误差修正框架（假设变量非平稳且处于长期均衡）、一阶差分模型（假设变量非平稳但不存在长期均衡）以及OLS框架（假设模型变量平稳）。在三种框架下，结论总体上较为稳健：工资随大米价格变化而同向调整，在优选模型中，短期弹性为0.29至0.57，长期弹性为0.70至1.0。福利影响分析表明，尽管严重依赖农业工资作为收入来源的家庭会因大米价格下降而受到不利影响，但其他家庭将从中受益。
